title: Decide layering: lib/site-brand.ts imports from renderers/pretext/layouts.ts

comments.author: home
comments.text:
DESIGN DECISION raised by the agent that did PPY-d79ff2. Low priority, but record the call rather than leaving it implicit.

lib/site-brand.ts now imports PRETEXT_LAYOUTS from renderers/pretext/layouts.ts, so getPresentationChoices() uses one real source of truth instead of a duplicated literal array. That inverts the usual layering: lib/ (shared) now depends on renderers/ (an implementation).

The agent confirmed there is no import cycle (layouts.ts imports only content-types, as a type). The tradeoff is real either way: the duplicate literal was a genuine correctness hazard, but lib/ depending on a specific renderer is exactly the coupling this initiative exists to remove - and it gets worse when a second renderer lands.

OPTIONS: (a) leave it and accept the inversion; (b) have each renderer declare its layouts through the Renderer interface and let site-brand ask the ACTIVE renderer, which fits the architecture better and removes the static dependency; (c) move the canonical list to lib/ and have the Pretext renderer import it downward.

(b) is most aligned with where this is going. Decide once the config work in PPY-eca592 lands, since that is where the active renderer becomes resolvable.
